citations.assessment: The related heading calls Tavyomi Mar son of Rav Ashi. That link identifies the related source entry.
Mar directly calls Father’s statement a youthful one and raises the objections that follow.
The reported replacement explanation by Mar son of Rav Ashi is explicit in the inheritance passage.
Berakhot mentions Mar as a third participant and calls them equal; the connected Heilprin article expressly says equal in age and wisdom. Keep the terse two-name expression here.
Ravina addresses Mar son of Rav Ashi in the caper discussion with the alternative about following Beit Shammai.
The Bavli names Mar as imposing the ban when the vessel broke and the demon caused the damage; the decision and explanation follow.
The exact case concerns characteristics of the sinews, including whiteness. Digital Tosafot names this as one variant exception alongside turning over the oath.

The exact gloss on 83a gives three reports: always except oath reversal and acknowledgment; always except oath reversal and whiteness; and only in oath reversal and acknowledgment. Its attribution of the third view to Rav Hai and Rabbenu Gershom differs from the Rif’s attribution to Rav Hai.
The cited Tosafot supplies admission and oath reversal for one version, and whiteness plus oath reversal for another.
The case is recording an acknowledgment, with an explicit ruling voiced by Mar. This is the basis for the odiyta label.
The second Ḥullin pointer leads to the 76b whiteness discussion and comparison in Tosafot.
The explicit case concerns transfer of the oath and Mar’s position regarding an oath imposed by Torah law.
The retrieved Rif names Rav Hai and gives oath reversal and whiteness with the mnemonic. The ruling is presented alongside competing reports above.

holds.reason: This is Heilprin’s account. Other chronological traditions identify a longer conclusion of instruction; the root does not cite an exact independent witness to this asserted role.
The related Rav Mordekhai article reports his own exchanges with Rav Ashi but does not directly synchronize his career with this Mar. Retain Heilprin’s attribution.
